name: Colors Of The Rainbow
overview: The colors of the rainbow and other hues mentioned in Scripture symbolize God's covenant, purity, and divine beauty. In Genesis 9:13, the rainbow is established as a sign of God's promise to the earth, while Isaiah 1:18 contrasts scarlet and crimson sin with the cleansing purity of white as snow. The rich colors of purple, blue, and crimson found in Esther 1:6 and Proverbs 31:22 reflect honor and dignity, yet Jeremiah 4:30 warns that outward adornment cannot mask spiritual ruin. Ultimately, the Word, who is God (John 1:1), undergirds these symbols with eternal truth and redemption.
